desc: Derive the exact transition table for one position: for s_i = 0, allowed d_i are 0,1,2; for s_i = 1, allowed d_i are 0,1,2,3; list all possible edge-state transitions a_{i-1} -> a_i for each case.

Encode each label transition as a 4-bit Boolean 2x2 matrix, and precompute for every relation mask and every s_i bit the aggregated next masks with multiplicities, using Boolean matrix multiplication.
Implement the main DP over relation masks: initialize the identity relation, process the string left to right, update counts modulo 998244353, and ensure the loop is optimized for N = 10^6.
Compute the final answer by summing DP counts of relation masks whose diagonal contains at least one reachable state, since this exactly enforces the circular consistency of the cycle orientations.
Reduce the DP state space using the swap symmetry of cycle states, with correct orbit averaging and final acceptance weights.
Optimize processing with precomputed 10-bit block transitions to handle N up to 10^6 efficiently in Python.
Validate the implementation with the provided samples and the cycle-only sanity check; sample tests passed.
